Last night layer4 still failed honestly (N_matching=2/N_closed=1, epic bd-2osmh open). Tonight bd-pzlhv is the ONLY match for BOTH plans, so N_closed==N_matching holds for both and a literal reading of the positive-proof gate would have archived TWO un-beadified, loop-ready plans. The gate's arithmetic did not save this run; reading bd-pzlhv's body did — its description contains an explicit 'EXPLICITLY NOT PROPOSED (checked and withheld this run)' section naming both plans, and its close_reason records the human decision 'The 2 loop-ready plans left in place'.

This is a decaying-safety failure mode, not a stable one: every nightly proposal that NAMES a withheld plan becomes a closed match for that plan the following night, and as the honest implementation beads close out, the proposal beads become the ONLY matches — at which point N_closed==N_matching is guaranteed to pass. The gate gets more dangerous over time, not less. layer4 is the proof: it degraded from a genuine fail to a spurious pass in one night. ESCALATING the fix from 'recommendation' to 'the Tier-2 gate is not currently sound'. Minimum fix: exclude labels pipeline-proposal (and arguably human-gate) from N_matching. Better fix: require N_matching to contain at least one bead whose type is task/bug/feature — a plan is only provably done when IMPLEMENTATION beads closed, never when a proposal merely mentioned it.
